model.name: Interactive-v2
model.pointsModel: position- and role-conditioned CatBoost mean and quantile regressors
model.optimizer: multi-matchday mixed-integer model solved with HiGHS
model.objective: sum of expected points from the best valid XI in every matchday with a three-player position-preserving winter window

validation.protocol: ensemble selected on one preseason validation season; final metrics use a later untouched preseason holdout
